Sharp 2n follows from Q_0=n-1 and E_(n-1)=0 on rows {0,n-1}; n=1 has separate sharp 1. Finite checks are evidence corroborating, not a general-size proof.

value.rationale: The full-language pointwise semantic relation quotient is a natural object in four-modal intuitionistic frame semantics. Its realizability admits a complete independent local test, and the sharp per-class edge minimum and global 2n optimum make that exact classification structurally useful even when the raw relation has n^2 arrows. The all-size result is not just a renaming or a table recomputation; class counts through size five independently check the new structural criterion.
